_note: PC1 asserts LK1 goes red on this fixture for exactly these reasons. Inert text: the names are made up and every address is on the .invalid domain, so nothing here resolves or installs. The .npmrc line reads, to a URL parser, as a user (mirror.example.invalid;) on bad.example.invalid, but npm's ini reader ends the value at the ; and uses mirror.example.invalid. The two disagree, so no host is trusted and the tarball on bad.example.invalid fails.
